dated: Income Tax Act (ULII consolidation 2024-12-23); NSSF Act (2022-01-07)

entries.name: Withholding tax on dividends (resident)
entries.statute: ITA s. 128 (1); Third Schedule Part IX para 1 (15 %)
entries.doc: Third Schedule Part IX: "1. The withholding tax rate applicable for interest and dividend payments to a resident person under sections 127 and 128 excluding interest on government securities is 15%. 2. The withholding tax rate applicable for dividend payments from companies listed on the stock exchange to individuals under section 128 is 10%. 3. The withholding tax rate for interest payments on Government securities to a resident person ... (a) twenty percent ... not exceed ten years; (b) ten percent ... at least ten years."
notes: ITA Third Schedule Part IX: 10 % for listed-company dividends to individuals not separable; withholding booked as the final charge on the item (finality of s. 127-128 for individuals not checked)

entries.name: Withholding tax on interest (resident)
entries.statute: ITA s. 127 (1); Third Schedule Part IX para 1 (15 %)
notes: interest on government securities 20 % / 10 % (Part IX para 3) not separable

entries.name: NSSF standard contribution (employer share)
entries.statute: NSSF Act s. 11 (1) (15 % of total wages), s. 12 (1) (employee share 5 %): employer 10 %
entries.doc: s. 11 (1): "every contributing employer shall ... pay to the fund ... a standard contribution of 15 percent calculated on the total wages paid during that month to that employee"; s. 12 (1): "A contributing employer may deduct from the monthly wage payment of his or her employee the employee's share of a standard contribution of 5 percent".

entries.name: Stamp duty on transfers (land, buildings, unlisted shares)
entries.statute: Stamp Duty Act 2014, Schedule 2 item 63 (a) (ULII consolidation eng@2023-12-31; amendments after 2023 not checked)
entries.doc: Schedule 2 item 63: transfer, 1,5 % of the total value; (b) transfers of listed shares arising from trading on the stock exchange 0,5 %.
unsupported: exempted transfers (item 63 (c)-(d): special purpose vehicles, Islamic finance) and Nil items for licensed investors
